title: Mutmaßliches Gewaltverbrechen – Zweiter Tatverdächtiger in Untersuchungshaft

extraction.summaryEn: A man was allegedly abducted in a forest area in Waidmannslust in April 2026 and later a male body was found in a forest near Potsdam. The homicide unit now investigates a suspected killing, and a second suspect, age 32, has been placed in pre-trial detention.
